body:
ws-spec-to-pr orchestrator could observe/watch for errors during execution pipeline and log it

- add to state file the age transcription paths (if available) for helping ws-monitor to watch
- auto start a watcher sharing same ideas of ws-monitor skill via config.json key configuration `autoStartObserver: false by default`
- if (autoStartObserver == true), verify if can dispatch a parallel subagent only for watching and reporting state/execution and monitor errors/bugs in skills intructions/mistakes, log it and propose fixes in github repo
- try to share skill instructions between ws-monitor and the orchestrator.

this watcher is only for the workflow-skills execution, not consumer related project implementation.

if everything works ok after this refinement/implementation, then we could in future remove ws-monitor skill or not. Decide if later.
title: ws-spec-to-pr orchestrator could dispatch and observer/watcher for errors during execution
